justified_path_changes: src/update/state.rs: an installed bin/axiom-cli resolves its own root (needed so an adopted non-default root works without AXIOM_* variables)
src/runtime.rs, src/pathenv.rs: nested runtime and adopted PATH entry

lanes.windows-x64: verified (real host; real 0.1.2 bootstrap root from the published bootstrap_windows.ps1, fixture 0.1.0 CLI store, redirected LOCALAPPDATA/USERPROFILE/PATH)

commands.command: python tests/l006_adopt_legacy.py --release <v0.1.2 windows-x64 extract> --cli target/release/axiom-cli.exe --work <short temp dir>

limitations: the 0.1.0 CLI store is a fixture mirroring the J-004 layout (its executable is the published 0.1.2 CLI, so the PATH probe reports 0.1.2); the 0.1.2 bootstrap root is real
the operator's real %LOCALAPPDATA%\Axiom and %USERPROFILE%\axiom were only read, never adopted
leftover AXIOM_* user variables are reported, not removed (they belong to the user)
POSIX legacy layouts (bootstrap_linux.py roots, ~/.local/share/axiom stores) are classified by the same rules but not executed here
